title: real-time token cost forecasting and attribution proxy
creator: Ayla Chen
description: Build a lightweight proxy service that produces near-real-time per-request token cost forecasts and attribution metadata for the Console and billing pipeline. The proxy will subscribe to streaming usage/telemetry events, enrich events with model/pricing profiles (including quantization and variant factors), and emit an estimated cost attribution record that the Console can display and the billing stack can consume for alerting and early anomaly detection. This is intentionally optimistic (estimated) and not the final invoice source of truth — final reconciliation will continue to rely on the monthly ledger job. The goal is to provide customers and SREs timely visibility into cost spikes and route-level hot spots while keeping the added latency and operational complexity minimal.
acceptance_criteria: Proxy emits cost-estimate record for >= 99% of valid inference requests within 5s of request completion
End-to-end latency overhead introduced by the proxy < 10ms p95 for typical HTTP request path
Estimated cost per-day aggregates are within 0.5% of reconciled ledger totals in controlled synthetic workloads
Feature flag can disable enrichment to fall back to conservative default pricing with zero downtime
Integration tests (unit + load) and a canary rollout plan documented and ready for QA
tasks: Design event schema and canonical attributes for cost attribution records (product, route, model_variant, tokens_in/out, kv_cache_hit)
Implement streaming ingest and joiner in Go (gRPC/HTTP) with bounded memory footprint and backpressure handling
Add pricing profile cache with TTL and fallback heuristics for unknown models/variants
Implement sampling path for very high-throughput customers to avoid amplification (configurable sampling ratio)
Add metrics/tracing (Prometheus + Honeycomb) and dashboards for proxy throughput, estimate accuracy, and error rate
End-to-end test harness: synthetic workload generator, golden ledger comparison, and resiliency tests
Prepare migration and canary in Console with feature flag and rollout playbook
notes: 2026-02-25: Kickoff — alignment with PM and Console team. Decided to prioritize read-path for Console visibility first, then route to billing ingestion in phase 2.

2026-02-27: Architecture review — trade-offs discussed: providing exact per-token charge vs approximate low-latency estimate. Chosen approach: approximate with confidence band + deterministic fallback for reconciliation.
2026-03-02: Decision to use an in-memory pricing cache per pod with async refresh from Pricing Service to meet latency constraints. TTL default 60s and exponential backoff on failures.
2026-03-04: Security review flagged need to redact customer identifiers in forwarded estimate payloads; will use ephemeral request IDs and reference map in internal audit log service.
2026-03-06: Perf prototype shows 7ms added p95 on a c5d-like instance. Need further tuning for dedicated GPU frontends — Rafael to investigate kernel-level batching interaction.
